objective: Test the exact-firmware MassBoot boot condition on the purchased v42012 Ditoo Plus and capture only the USB/PnP identity produced by ordinary Windows enumeration. No custom USB command, storage access, firmware read/write, or service protocol action is permitted.

static_evidence.key_id_3_mapping: Lighting button (high confidence from exact manual numbering + firmware/capture cross-checks)
static_evidence.startup_gate: normal startup configures/reads GPIO 0x1E (30) and calls 0x1b8f4(1) only when GPIO30 is high
static_evidence.gpio30_interpretation: high-confidence external-power/charge condition: used by Ditoo offline-charge startup logic; AK1052D pin mux maps GPIO30 to ISENSE
static_evidence.physical_hypothesis: data-capable USB/external power present + Lighting held stably during ordinary startup

preconditions.sd_card: removed; SD updater is not part of this experiment
preconditions.product_runtime: may be stopped before the experiment to avoid Bluetooth/product reconnect noise; this does not widen USB authority
preconditions.windows: Administrator PowerShell available for mountvol automount suppression
preconditions.usb_cable: known data-capable USB cable connected directly to the Windows PC

operation.phase_a_baseline: With no special key held, observe the Ditoo under normal USB-attached startup and record present Windows PnP/USB/disk identities. Do not open or browse any new volume.
operation.phase_b_candidate: Disable automatic mounting of newly discovered volumes; power the Ditoo fully off; hold the Lighting key; attach the known data-capable USB cable and keep Lighting held through startup. If cable insertion does not itself start the unit, use only the normal power-on action while continuing to hold Lighting. Release Lighting after the device/Windows reaches a stable state or after 5 seconds of boot activity. Record only ordinary Windows PnP/USB/disk enumeration metadata.
operation.stop_on_new_identity: As soon as a new/different USB/PnP identity attributable to the Ditoo is observed, the experiment is complete. Do not interact with that interface.

host_write_minimization.before_phase_b: Run mountvol /N from Administrator PowerShell to disable automatic mounting of newly discovered volumes.
host_write_minimization.during: Do not assign a drive letter, browse a volume, initialize a disk, format, run CHKDSK, or allow any application to index/open a newly exposed device.
host_write_minimization.after: Run mountvol /E to restore automatic mounting, even if MassBoot does not enumerate.
host_write_minimization.note: Windows standard USB enumeration/descriptor traffic is inherently allowed; no application-level command beyond read-only OS enumeration is authorized.

evidence_to_capture: before/after Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly entries for USB/DiskDrive/WPD classes
hardware instance IDs and VID/PID if exposed by normal PnP enumeration
Get-Disk/Get-Volume metadata only if Windows itself exposes an object; do not mount/browse it
visible Ditoo screen/LED behavior and whether normal Runtime 018/Bluetooth startup occurs

expected_results.positive: A USB/PnP identity appears in Phase B that is absent from normal Phase A, especially a boot/service/mass-storage identity. This proves exact-unit MassBoot entry/enumeration but not any command semantics.
expected_results.negative: No new identity is inconclusive; timing or v42012 boot-selector details may differ. Do not automatically retry.
expected_results.unexpected: Any Windows prompt to initialize/format/repair a disk, any unexplained persistent device state, or any behavior suggesting a write-capable update/recovery workflow. Cancel/dismiss host prompts without acting and stop.

risk.reason: No intentional device write or custom USB command occurs, but the test intentionally enters a boot/service state whose exact v42012 USB presentation is not yet known. Host automount is suppressed to reduce incidental writes.

stop_policy.on_positive: capture identity only, restore Windows automount, then power-cycle the Ditoo normally with Lighting released; do not issue any command to the new interface
stop_policy.on_no_enumeration: restore automount, return Ditoo to normal boot, preserve observations, stop
stop_policy.on_host_prompt: cancel/dismiss without initialize/format/repair; restore automount and stop

authority.grant_scope: ONE normal-USB baseline and ONE Lighting+USB MassBoot candidate startup on the exact purchased v42012 unit, ordinary Windows enumeration only, automount suppressed for candidate, no custom USB/SCSI/vendor command and no firmware/RAM read or write.

result.operator_observation: With Lighting held during the candidate startup, the Ditoo did not complete its normal boot; behavior was consistent with entering a service/USB-boot-like state. After the experiment it was power-cycled normally with Lighting released.
result.interpretation: Physical behavior strongly supports that Lighting+external-power reaches a different boot path consistent with the statically proven MassBoot selector, but host-side MassBoot enumeration through the retail USB-C connector is NOT proven. Normal baseline also exposed no Ditoo USB/PnP identity, so absence of a candidate identity may reflect retail USB-C topology rather than failed selector entry.
result.massboot_entry_confidence: strong behavioral support; not host-enumeration proof
